tools.name: swoogo_list_events
tools.description: List the events in the Swoogo account with dates, timezone, status and registration URL. Start here to find an event_id. Swoogo API: GET /events.

tools.name: swoogo_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id, with its full settings: name, dates, timezone, capacity, status and registration URL. Swoogo API: GET /events/{event_id}.

tools.name: swoogo_list_registrants
tools.description: List the registrants of one event with their registration type and status. Use search to filter, for example registration_status=confirmed. Swoogo API: GET /registrants (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_get_registrant
tools.description: Get one registrant by id, with their registration details and status. Swoogo API: GET /registrants/{registrant_id}.

tools.name: swoogo_list_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (agenda items) of one event with their times, track and location. Swoogo API: GET /sessions (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_get_session
tools.description: Get one session by id, with its title, times, track and location. Swoogo API: GET /sessions/{session_id}.

tools.name: swoogo_list_speakers
tools.description: List the speakers of one event. Swoogo API: GET /speakers (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_list_sponsors
tools.description: List the sponsors of one event. Swoogo API: GET /sponsors (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_list_tracks
tools.description: List the session tracks of one event. Swoogo API: GET /tracks (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_list_locations
tools.description: List the rooms and venues of one event. Swoogo API: GET /locations (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_list_registrant_types
tools.description: List the registration types (ticket or badge categories) of one event. Swoogo API: GET /reg-types (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_list_transactions
tools.description: List the payment transactions of one event. Swoogo API: GET /transactions (costs 10 API credits per call).

tools.name: swoogo_list_session_attendance
tools.description: List session attendance records (which registrant attended which session) for one event. Swoogo API: GET /session-attendances (costs 10 API credits per call).
